root: ^...Just the two of you? The old man studies the three armed travelers standing before him.
^I was expecting a mercenary company. Instead, I got two sellswords and a cart that's seen better days.
^Then again... the companies worth hiring never answered my request. Either they're already under contract... or they decided this village wasn't worth saving.
^I can't blame them. What little coin we had is here.
^. *He places a small pouch on the table.*
^It's not enough to make anyone rich. But if you can keep those creatures from reaching our homes, every family in Ashbrook will owe you their lives.
^They're coming! A whole pack of them!
^He looks toward your group. You've got your contract.
^If you truly intend to make a name for yourselves... Now's the time to start.
